synesthesia.label: Pic sensoriel
synesthesia.criterion: vivid sensory distortions: senses blending together (hearing colors, tasting shapes) and surfaces breathing, melting or forming fractal patterns

dissolution.label: Dissolution
dissolution.criterion: ego dissolution: the speaker's sense of self dissolving into a cosmic unity with everything, timelessness and mystical oneness

afterglow.label: Rémanence
afterglow.criterion: calm, renewed serenity: gratitude, warmth, love and fresh wonder at simple everyday things
